1. The Registered Office or one of the Branch Offices of the Service Provider Company / Firm / Agency sh ould be located within the district of Kasaragod/Kan nur in Keralam state. 2. The Service provider must provide the details of similar service provided / Carried out in similar organisations. Also t he copies of the documents may be obtained. GENERAL i. The contract is likely to commence w.e.f. 01.12.2026 and shall continue for a period of two year, unless it is curtailed or terminated by this Offi ce owing to deficiency of service, sub-standard quality of personnel deployed, b reach of contract, reduction or cessation of the requirements of work or indiscipl ine. ii. The contract shall automatically expire after two years from commence ment of the contract unless extended further by the mutual consent of contracti ng Agency and this Office. iii. The contract may be extended, on the same terms and conditions or with some addition/deletion/ modification’ for a further period not exceeding on e year at the sole discretion of Office of the Principal Commissioner of Income T ax, Kozhikode. iv. The contracting Company/ Firm/ Agency will be required to pay minimu m wages as prescribed under the Minimum Wages as per Acts under Central/ St ate Government. The contracting agency will maintain proper records as requir ed under Law/Acts. It shall be the duty of the contracting company /agency to e nhance the wages of the employee’s subject to any statutory obligation / raise fr om time to time as instructed by authorities concerned in this behalf. However, such statuary enhancement shall be claimed from the department by the contr acting agency on furnishing documentary proof of payment of such amount to it s employees and this enhancement / raise shall be deemed to be agreed upon b etween the department and contracting agency / company. v. The requirement of this office may further increase or decrease during the period of contract and the contracting agency would have to provide additio nal Attendants, if required on the same terms and conditions. vi. The contracting Company/ Firm/ Agency shall not be allowed to transfer , assign, pledge or sub-contract its rights and liabilities under this contract to an y other Agency without the prior written consent of this Office. vii. The contractor shall have an experience of not less than 3 years in Dep artment of Revenue and should have a registered office in the district of Kasara god or Kannur. viii. The tendered will be bound by the details furnished by it to this Office, while submitting the tender or at any subsequent stage. In case any of the docu ments furnished by it is found to be false at any stage, it would be deemed to b e a breach of terms of contract, making the tendered liable for legal action besi des the termination /cancellation of contract, legal action for damages at the sol e discretion of the Income Tax Officer, Ward-1& TPS, Kasaragod and in such eve ntuality, the performance security amount tendered shall be liable to be forfeite d. ix. Financial bids of only those renderers shall be evaluated who are declar ed technically qualified. x. The Office of the Income Tax Officer, Watrd-1&TPS , Kasaragod reserv es the right to terminate the contract at any time without giving any notice xi. The contracting Agency shall ensure that the manpower deployed in th e Income Tax Office, Kasaragod conforms to the eligibility conditions of age, ed ucation and any other qualification as specified in the contract. xii. In case, the person employed by the successful Company/ Firm/ Agenc

y performs any act of omission/ commission that amounts to misconduct / indisc ipline/ incompetence and security risks, the successful Company/ Firm/ Agency will be liable to take appropriate disciplinary and legal action against such perso ns, including their removal from site of work, if required by the Office immediat ely after being brought to their notice. xiii. The service provider shall provide identity card carrying the photograph of the personnel and personal information including name, date of birth, addres s, designation etc. and uniform to the personnel deployed in this Office xiv. The service provider shall ensure that any details of office, operational process, technical know-how, Security arrangements, and administrative/ organ izational matters are not divulged or disclosed to any person by its personnel de ployed in the Office. xvii. The service provider shall ensure proper conduct of its personnel in offic e premises, maintenance of strict discipline in and around the office premises a nd enforce prohibition of consumption of alcoholic drinks, chewing pan, smoking , loitering without work etc. or consuming any other intoxicant substance, food or drink during the work hours / being on duty to maintain discipline and office decorum. xviii. The Agency shall depute a coordinator, out of the deployed personnel, who would be responsible for immediate interaction with the Office of the Incom e Tax Officer, Ward-1& TPS, Kasaragod so that optimal services of the persons deployed by the agency could be availed without any disruption. However the o ffice of the Income Tax Officer, Ward-1& TPS, Kasaragod shall be fully competen t and empowered to remove any indiscipline personnel / staff from its premises if his/ her behaviour is not up-to the mark, immoral and / or his /her presence is prejudicial / embarrassing to the department. xix. The selected Agency shall immediately provide a substitute in the eve nt of any person leaving the job due to his/ her personal reasons or being remov ed by this office. The delay by the Agency in providing a substitute beyond thre e working days shall attract liquidated damages @ Rs. 100 per day ( per such c ase) on the service providing Agency, besides deduction in payment on pro- rat a basis. xx. It will be the responsibility of the service providing Agency to meet tran sportation, food, medical and any other requirements in respect of the persons deployed by it (Agency) in this Office and this Office will have no liabilities in thi s regard. xxi. For all intents and purposes, the service providing Agency shall be the “ Employer” within the meaning of different Labour Legislations in respect of man power so employed and deployed in this Office. The persons deployed by the Ag ency in the Office shall not have claims of any Master and Servant relationship n or have any principal and agent relationship with or against the Office of the Inc ome Tax Officer, Ward-1& TPS, Kasaragod. xxii. The service providing Agency shall be solely responsible for the redres sed of grievances /resolution of disputes relating to persons deployed. This Offic e shall, in no way, be responsible for settlement of such issues whatsoever as th is office shall have no concern of contract with the work force. xxiii. This Office shall not be responsible for any damages, losses, claims, fina

ncial or other, injury to any person deployed by service providing Agency in the course of their performing the functions/ duties, or for payment towards any co mpensation. xxiv. The persons deployed by the service providing Agency shall not claim n or shall be entitled to be paid, perks and other facilities admissible to casual, ad hoc, regular/ confirmed employees of this Office during the contract or after exp iry of the contract. That any issue of pay, perks, statutory obligations , welfare s chemes or monetary benefits / internal arrangements of the employees , their p ersonal insurance (If any) shall be looked after by the contracting agency and th e department has no interference or liability of any nature in any manner whats oever. xxv. In case of termination of this contract on its expiry or otherwise, the pe rsons deployed by the service providing Agency shall not be entitled to and will have no claim, for any absorption nor for any relaxation for absorption in the re gular/ other capacity in the Income Tax Officer, Ward-1& TPS, Kasaragod. In bri ef there shall be no privacy of contract between the department and the individ uals / work force provided by the service provider / contracting agency. xxvi. The contracting agency should communicate above conditions to the p erson deployed in this office by the contracting agency. xxvii. The contractor shall ensure availability of liquid soaps in wash basins. N aphthalene balls and toilet papers in urinals and toilets, refilling the same, mos quito repellents as when required. The cost of consumables like phenyl, soap, oi l, cleaning acids, mops, toilet cleaners, room fresheners, tissue papers and equi pments and equipments like vacuum cleaners, buckets, mugs, dusters etc. used for cleaning shall be borne by the contractor. The sum up cost of all consu mables used for any of the services contracted for shall be fully borne by the co ntractor, which shall be included in the contract rate xxviii. Payments shall be made only to the contracting agency on monthly b asis as per actual services. The contracting agency has to raise invoices in the fi rst week of the next month through GeM for the services rendered in the month . DETAILS OF SERVICE TO BE DONE 1. Outcomes expected from the Procurement of Services: The Duties of the Outsourced staff are as follows: A: Caretaker of guest house i) To be present at the guest house at the check in time of guests a nd to hand over the room keys ii) Provide food and beverages as and when required by the guests. iii) Daily cleaning and up keeping of the guest house and immediate premises. iv) To ensure that tea bags, drinking water bottles etc. are placed in the rooms before the arrival of the guests. v) To ensure that toiletries, tooth brush, tooth paste etc. are placed

before the arrival of the guests. vi) To be present at the time of check out and to accept guest room r ent and issue receipts to the guests and hand over the rent to the c oncerned staff. vii) Properly clean the rooms after the check out of the guests. viii) Proper and safe custody of the inventories accounted for the Gues t House The manpower employed by the Agency shall be required to attend the duties at any time depending upon the arrival and departure of the gu ests on all days. If the caretaker fails to attend duty on any day no wage s hall be paid to the contractor in respect of absence from duty by the depl oyed personnel. A. HOUSE KEEPING STAFF-CLEANING STAFF FOR OFFICE Purpose/Objective Statement of Services i) Description of service: Hiring of two numbers of Cleaning Staffs for Income Tax Office, Kasara god. The hired Cleaning staffs are proposed to carry out cleaning duties in t he above said office daily from Monday to Saturday from 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM. The office building is a 3 storey building consists of 15 big roo ms, 1 hall, 2 corridors, 7 toilet rooms, 1 porch, staircases, 2 glass cano py, 16 solar panel at roof top and surrounding courtyards on the groun d. The service provider should bring cleaning materials/equipments wh ich includes floor tiles cleaning power machine, mops, broom stick, sta ndard cleaning lotion for floor, Glass, toilets etc. The Duties of the Outsourced staff are as follows: 1. The staff must report in proper uniform of their Agency and display th eir Identity Cards. 2. The place of duty shall normally be at the Income Tax Office Premises at Kasaragod but services may be utilized in any office/Dept. for special arr angements if need so arise. 3. Cleaning, sweeping and mopping of officer’s room, staff room, corridors, waiting areas, library, toilets etc. twice a day and mopping with disinfec tant lotion using power equipments, Sweeping of staircases, cleaning, du sting and mopping of railings, window sills and projected beams should b e done daily. Wet mopping of staircase railing should be done with hand s daily. Cleaning, dusting of furniture etc. should be completed well befor e the commencement of office. 4. Washing of with soap solution once in a week. Wet mopping, dusting of c urtains, walls, windows, wall hung lights, ventilators, glass partitions/pan es, exhaust fans, ceiling fans, AC blowers etc. should be done daily. 5. Maintenance of bathrooms and toilets, scrubbing of walls, washing of was hbasin with disinfectants/cleaning liquids/lotion daily in the morning. Re moving of cobwebs from the rooms, ceiling and toilets on day to day basi s. Bad odour from closets, washbasin and urinals is to be removed imme

diately. Ensure toilets seats are kept neat and tidy. Toilets should be clea ned twice daily. Urinal Screens to be installed and the same must be repl aced every month 6. Emptying of dustbins and collections of garbage from the offices an d other areas and burn it. The burning should be completed before 8. 00 am every day. 7. Sweeping of surrounding areas clean and free of garbage and animal/bird droppings etc. 8. Protection of equipments, fixtures, plants greenery and other movable/im movable properties of the office. 9. Abuse of electricity/water/telephones services by the agency is prohibite d. 10. To maintain highest order of integrity, moral and social responsibili ty especially towards ladies, children and senior citizens. 11. Suitable number of female sweepers to be provided as per requirement or as advised by the administration and instructions as given by the Auth orities/ Administration Branch staff to be strictly followed. 12. An inventory of cleaning materials, equipments, Tile cleaning machines and other appliances used by the House Keeping Staff should be maintai ned by the Agency and should be produced whenever directed by the au thority. 13. Mopping of the floors using machines at least once a month is mandator y. 14. Cleaning of window panes, Interior and Exterior to be carried out regular ly. Interior windows daily and Exterior once in a week. 15. Cleaning of porch, Glass Canopy and Solar panel once in a week. 16. Minor plumbing works to be carried out – i.e blockages in washroom etc. 17. Reporting of any missing fittings, taps or bulbs immediately to th e Security Guard/Caretaker/Estate Officer. 18. Cleaning of parking once in a week 19. Any other work of similar nature assigned by the authorities of concern ed Office. The manpower employed by the Agency shall be required to work as per t he Office’s working timings, i.e. from Monday to Saturday from 07:30 hrs. to 16: 00 hrs. with a lunch break of ½ hour from 13:15 hrs. to 13:45 hrs. At times, the deployed manpower may be required to work on Sundays, Gazetted Holidays fo r which they shall be paid as per prevailing law. The Attendance of the deployed personnel shall be monitored. It may be made mandatory for all deployed staff members to put signature in the attenda nce register for marking attendance and if deployed staffs fail to put signature i n the attendance register, no wage shall be paid to the contractor for the same. The attendance system shall deduct half day wage if the deployed staff marks h is/her attendance after 07.40 AM and before 03:50 PM to ensure punctuality of t he office. 2. Capabilities required for carrying out the assignments: Since the hired caretaker is required to communicate with guests who are not proficient in Malayalam, the minimum qualification criteria may be set to “Secondary School Leaving Certificate” with adequate knowledge in Hi ndi/English.

3. Precedence and similar assignments carried out earlier in our organisation/sim ilar organisations The Service provider must provide the details of similar service provided / carried out in similar organisations also the copies of the documents may be obt ained. FRAUD AND CORRUPT PRACTICES The applicant and their respective officers, employees, agents and advisers sh all observe the highest standard of ethics during the Bidding Process. Notwithst anding anything to the contrary contained herein, the Office may reject an appli cation without being liable in any manner whatsoever to the Applicant if it deter mines that the Applicant has, directly or indirectly or through an agent, engage d in corrupt practice, fraudulent practice, coercive practice, undesirable practic e or restrictive practice in the Bidding Process. Without prejudice to the rights of this Office under Clause i. hereinabove, if an A pplicant is found by this Office to have directly or indirectly or through an agent, engaged or indulged in any corrupt practice, fraudulent practice, coercive practi ce, undesirable practice or restrictive practice during the Bidding Process, such Applicant shall not be eligible to participate in any tender issued by this Office d uring a period of 2 (two) years from the date such Applicant is found by the Offi ce to have directly or indirectly or through an agent, engaged or indulged in any corrupt practice, fraudulent practice, coercive practice, undesirable practice or restrictive practice as the case may be. For the purposes of this clause 1, the following terms shall have the meaning he reinafter respectively assigned to then: “Corrupt practice” means (i) the offering, giving, receiving, or soliciting, directly or indirectly, of anything of value to influence the actions of any person connected with the Bidding Process or (ii) sav e and except as permitted, engaging in any manner whatsoever, wh ether during the Bidding Process or after the issue of the LOA or aft er the execution of the Agreement, as the case may be, any person in respect of any matter relating to the Project or the LOA or the Agr eement, who at any time has been or is a legal, financial or technica l advisor of the Authority in relation to any matter concerning the Pr oject; a) “fraudulent practice” means a misrepresentation or omission of facts or suppression of facts or disclosure of incomplete facts, in order to influence the Bidding Process;

b) “coercive practice” means impairing or harming or t hreatening to impair or harm, directly or indirectly, a ny person or property to influence to any person’s pa rticipation or action in the Bidding Process; c) “undesirable practice” means (i) establishing conta ct with any person connected with or employed or en gaged by the Authority with the objective of canvassi ng, lobbying or in any manner influencing or attempti ng to influence the Bidding Process; or (ii) having a C onflict of Interest; and d) “restrictive practice” means forming a cartel or arri ving at any understanding or arrangement among Ap plicant with the objective of restricting or manipulating a full and fair competition in the Biddin g Process; LEGAL i The Service provider shall be responsible for compliance of all statutory provisions relating to Minimum wages, Employees’ Provident Fund, Employees State Insurance and other labour laws etc. in respect of the persons deployed b y it in this Office as this office has no privacy of contract with these employees. ii The Service provider shall also be liable for depositing all taxes, levies, C ass etc. on account of service rendered by it to the Office of the the Income Tax Officer, Ward-1& TPS, Kasaragodto concerned tax collection authorities from ti me to time as per extant rules and regulations on the matter. iii. The Service provider shall maintain all statutory registers under the applicable laws. The Agency shall produce the same, on demand, to the concer ned authority of this Office or any other authority under Law. iv. The Tax Deduction at Source (TDS) shall be made as per the provisions of Income Tax law, as amended from time to time and a certificate to this effect shall be provided to the Agency by this Office. v. In case, the tendering Agency fails to comply with any statutory/ taxati on liability under appropriate law and as a result thereof this Office is put to any loss, obligation, monetary or otherwise, this Office will be entitled to get itself re imbursed out of the outstanding bills or the Performance Security Deposit of the Agency, to the extent of the loss or obligation in monetary terms. FINANCIAL i. E-Performance bank guarantee (ePBG) from a Nationalized Bank/Bank Guarantee for 3% of Total Contracted amount for a period of 26 months is to be deposited by the successful bidder vide order No.F.9/4/2020-PPD dated 12.11.2 020

ii. The Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) amount to be deposited or submissio n of Bid Security Declaration will be done as per Rule 170 (iii) of GFR 2017. iii. In case of breach of any terms and conditions stipulated in the contract, the performance security Deposit of the Agency will be liable to be forfeited by t his Office besides annulment of the contract. iv. The Agency shall raise the bill, in triplicate, along with attendance shee t to the Division under whom the outsourced personnel has been deployed in th e first week of the succeeding month. The concerned office/officer will send the bills duly verified to the office of the Pr.Commissioner of Income Tax, AayakarBh avan, Mananchira, Kozhikode - 673001 for sanction and payment. vii. The claims in bills regarding Employees State Insurance, Provident Fun d, and Service Tax etc. should be necessarily accompanied with documentary p roof pertaining to the concerned month bill. A requisite portion of the bill/ whole of the bill amount shall be held up till the proof is furnished, at the discretion of this Office. viii. Settlement of disputes will be as per Indian Arbitration and Conciliation Act-1996 and venue will be the Office of the Income Tax Officer, Ward-1& TPS, Kasaragod. It is clarified that the sole arbitrator to adjudicate any disputes arising out of the proposed contract shall be nominated / appointed by the Inco me Tax Officer, Ward-1&TPS , Kasaragod. ix. Office of the Income Tax Officer, Ward-1& TPS, Kasaragod reserves the right to withdraw/ relax any of the terms and conditions mentioned above so as to overcome the problem encountered by the contracting parties.
